name: abyssal-teal-retired-values
purpose: CI guardrail input. Any build containing these exact strings FAILS. No aliases, no fallbacks, no exceptions. Copied verbatim from the Abyssal Teal handoff; exempt_paths extended for this project's record files only.
retired_values_other: letter-spacing: 2px /* legacy section-label tracking; new value is 3px */
exempt_paths_note: Exemption is by file path, never by value. reference/** holds the imported authority set (SPEC, tokens, wireframe copy, Andrew's pre-mapping code-source originals), wireframe/** the wireframe rendered at the bottom of the design guide (a record: it quotes retired values on purpose), and uploads/** the raw inputs. Nothing under tokens/, components/, ui_kits/, guidelines/ is exempt. TWO ENTRIES WERE REMOVED 2026-08-19, and both removals are subtractions on purpose. (1) ci/kill-list.mjs matched nothing: the gate's own source lives at design-system/ci/kill-list.mjs, and the exempt() test compares this pattern against the repository-relative path and the bare filename — neither is 'ci/kill-list.mjs'. The entry was REMOVED rather than corrected, because a corrected path would newly exempt a file that is scanned today and clean today: the gate holds no literal retired value, it reads every one of them from this file. (2) public/agent/squid.css was a deferral tied to a ruling, and this file's own note ordered its removal 'the moment /agent/ is retired'. mp#89 deleted the file and landed the ruled 301 for the bare path, and mp#91 flipped /agent/<handle> to /<handle>, so the deferral is spent. An exemption that names a deleted file is not harmless clutter — it is a standing invitation to re-create the file under cover of it.
notes: Old Deep Ocean surface scale (#0A0E14 family) is fully replaced by the trench scale in tokens/.
#E8F4F8 off-white is replaced by #E7F3F2. Both must not coexist.
Warm values #FF6B35 / #F7931A are NOT retired; they remain the squid mark, used nowhere else.
retired_rgb_forms_note: Every retired_hex value ALSO listed in decimal rgb()/rgba() notation. The gate matches exact strings, so #0A0E14 failed the build while the identical colour written rgba(10,14,20,0.85) passed clean — proven by control test 2026-08-18, and it was shipping in js/agent.js and js/marketplace.js. A hex-only law is a law about notation, not about colour.
